header.precision_interpretation: N*delta^2 / sum(A^2) is an upper-bound comparison, not an attribution. Ratio >= 1 is UNRESOLVED: rounding could cover all energy, but dominance is not proved. Zero energy has null ratio (ZERO_ADV_ENERGY). Stored delta combines score casting/float32 centering residual; separate original score pairs are unavailable in compact receipts.
header.quantile_definition: Exact pooled per-update values, linear interpolation at q*(n-1); q=0,.25,.5,.75,.9,.99,1. Each field count is its actual denominator; empty strata remain undefined.
header.scale_interpretation: Update-local denominator uses every original candidate, including zero groups. Correction=1; epsilon=1e-10 outside sqrt; numerator is not re-centered. Allzero gain is null, never reported as a real 1e10 policy amplification. Zero scene groups stay zero. No new A/reward/gradient is generated. Different update gains change relative weighting across updates and against BC; these statistics do not establish safety, gradient ratios or benefit. Repeated scene/log presentations are not iid.
